summary: This is a routine report of voting results from an annual general and special meeting of shareholders filed on Form 6-K by a Canadian foreign private issuer. The filing confirms the approval of standard matters: appointment of auditors, election of seven directors, amendments to the company's articles, and amendments to the omnibus equity incentive plan. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, going-private transaction, or management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine corporate governance update with no material corporate action triggering a special situation classification.
